executive_summary: Apex Logistics Solutions submitted a strong, highly aligned proposal that fits perfectly within the client's budget (€98,500 total) and meets all timeline milestones. All core technical and integration requirements (REQ-01 through REQ-06) are explicitly confirmed in the technical scope. However, the proposal completely omits REQ-07 (Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks), which is configured as a mandatory Score 5 Must-Have criterion. While the technical capabilities and pricing are commendable, this compliance omission prevents an immediate 'Accept' grade.
strengths: Exact alignment with the required budget (€98,500 falls comfortably within the €80,000–€120,000 range).
Meets the aggressive timeline requirements (3-month Munich pilot, 6-month full rollout across all 6 sites).
Explicitly covers all core technical must-haves including PostgreSQL integration, real-time dashboards, RBAC, automated low-stock alerts, and migration onboarding.
Clear, fixed-price commercial model including first-year support and 24/7 SLA terms.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Total omission of REQ-07 (Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks), which is a mandatory Score 5 requirement.
Lacks granular technical details regarding the architecture of the PostgreSQL integration and RBAC permission hierarchies in the initial submission.
Absence of formal risk mitigation strategies for multi-site warehouse deployment.

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Vendor explicitly confirms a web-based real-time inventory dashboard spanning all 6 regional warehouses.
Vendor confirms direct native integration with the existing customer PostgreSQL inventory database.
Vendor confirms implementation of role-based access control restricting managers to assigned sites.
Vendor includes configurable, automated low-stock notifications for designated managers.
Vendor commits to a detailed phased migration and user onboarding plan.
Vendor provides a fixed price including a 1-year 24/7 SLA support term.

scorecard.requirement_title: Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks
scorecard.evaluation_notes: Proposal completely omits the formal documentation of project assumptions, limitations, and operational risks.
